title: Settings
subtitle: Manage organization, security, data plane, and automation capabilities.

license_gated.title: Pro license required
license_gated.description: The {{feature}} feature is not enabled by this license. Configure a signed pro license that includes "{{feature}}" to use this page.

general.title: General
general.subtitle: Manage the current organization's basic information, stable identifiers, and access policies.

organization_information.title: Organization information
organization_information.subtitle: Manage the organization's display name and immutable system identifiers.

basic_information.title: Basic information
basic_information.subtitle: Configure how this organization appears in MoleSignal.

system_identity.title: System identity
system_identity.subtitle: Used by APIs, audit records, and support. These values cannot be changed after creation.

general.organization_name_hint: Shown in the organization switcher, page titles, and invitations. Saves automatically after you stop typing.
general.organization_slug_hint: Kept stable after creation and used by APIs and resource identifiers.
general.organization_id_hint: Used by APIs, audit records, and support diagnostics.
general.empty_description: No organization metadata was returned by the backend.

preference_defaults.title: Organization preference defaults
preference_defaults.subtitle: Applied when a user has not saved personal preferences. Personal preferences and current-page overrides take priority.

interface.title: Interface and defaults
interface.subtitle: These preferences apply only to your account and sync across signed-in devices.
interface.timezone_hint: Controls the default time display in logs, traces, and reports.
interface.default_home_hint: The page opened after sign-in or when you select the brand mark.

access_control.title: Access control
access_control.subtitle: Manage how members join and how organization resources may be accessed publicly.

signup.title: Registration and access
signup.subtitle: Control how new members join this organization and which access they receive.
signup.enabled_hint: Users who meet the platform signup requirements can join this organization.
signup.require_approval_hint: An administrator must approve join requests before users can access the organization.
signup.default_role_hint: Members who join through self-service receive the default role configured in the IAM catalog.

sharing.title: Sharing and public access
sharing.subtitle: Control restricted share credentials. Organization and cross-organization sharing still require sign-in.
sharing.allow_public_links_hint: Members may create restricted bearer links that do not require account sign-in for allowed resources.
sharing.public_links_required: Enable public links before configuring this option.
sharing.allow_public_dashboards_hint: Higher risk. The public view restricts queries, variables, time ranges, and navigation.
sharing.max_expiry_hint: Creators cannot choose an expiration beyond this limit.
sharing.report_password: Require a password for public reports
sharing.report_password_hint: A short-lived share session is issued only after password verification.
sharing.deny_production: Block public sharing for production resources
sharing.deny_production_hint: Reject public links for resources tagged production or prod.
sharing.allow_csv_download_hint: When off, CSV reports can only be previewed in the restricted page.

danger.title: Organization lifecycle
danger.subtitle: Manage irreversible actions that affect the organization and its data lifecycle.
danger.delete_description: The backend prevents deleting the organization used by the current session. Switch organizations first, then complete deletion from Organization management.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Set personal defaults that override workspace defaults. Query pages can temporarily override time display.
preferences.density_hint: Compact mode reduces rows and spacing in tables, log lists, navigation, and settings without changing charts, code, or conversation text.
preferences.keyboard_shortcuts_hint: Allow global navigation and command shortcuts.
preferences.default_timezone_hint: Used by dashboards, logs, metrics, and traces by default. Query pages can temporarily override it.
preferences.default_home_hint: The page opened after sign-in or when entering a workspace.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.description: Your preference changes have not been saved.

billing.title: Stripe integration
billing.subtitle: Configure platform-level Stripe subscription and quota enforcement. Customer plans and invoices are managed in Account settings.

hints.enabled: Gate ingestion on subscription state and daily quota.
hints.webhook_secret: Stripe `whsec_…`; used to verify webhook signatures. Blank keeps the current value.
hints.api_key: Stripe `sk_…`; stored encrypted. Blank keeps the current value.
hints.tolerance: Reject webhooks whose timestamp is older than this (replay protection).

license.title: License
license.subtitle: Active plan and entitlements.
license.current_description: Verified edition, entitlements, limits, and validity.
license.empty_description: No license snapshot was returned by the backend.

upload.title: Upload license
upload.subtitle: Paste the signed license payload and detached signature. Both fields are base64-encoded.
upload.toast_uploaded_unverified: License uploaded but failed signature verification
upload.validation_required: Both payload and signature are required
upload.validation_base64: Payload and signature must be valid base64

sso_providers.title: SSO providers
sso_providers.subtitle: OIDC, SAML, and LDAP identity providers users can sign in with.
sso_providers.empty_description: Add an OIDC, SAML, or LDAP provider for centrally managed sign-in.
sso_providers.delete_confirm_description: Users that depended on this provider will no longer be able to sign in via SSO.

drawer.subtitle: Configure the identity source and its secure authentication endpoints.

fields.name: Name
fields.secret_preserved_hint: Leave blank to keep the saved secret
fields.oidc_redirect_uri_hint: Register this URL as an allowed callback at the OIDC identity provider. It is derived from the MoleSignal external URL.
fields.saml_callback_url_hint: Register this URL as the Assertion Consumer Service URL at the SAML identity provider. It is derived from the MoleSignal external URL.
fields.ldap_url_hint: Use ldaps://, or ldap:// with StartTLS enabled
fields.start_tls_hint: Required for ldap://; disable for ldaps://
fields.user_filter_hint: Must include {username}; the value is escaped before search
fields.bind_pair_hint: Leave both bind fields empty only when anonymous search is allowed

mapping.oidc_hint: Map MoleSignal identity fields to OIDC claims. Dot-separated paths such as realm_access.roles are supported.
mapping.saml_hint: Map MoleSignal identity fields to SAML Attribute names. Use NameID to read the assertion subject.
mapping.ldap_hint: Map MoleSignal identity fields to LDAP attributes. Use dn to read the matched entry DN.
mapping.default_role_hint: Applied when no external group mapping matches. If omitted, the self-service signup role is used.
mapping.roles_empty: This organization has no assignable roles. Create an organization role in IAM first.
mapping.roles_unavailable: The role list is not available yet
mapping.group_roles_hint: Each matching external group grants the selected MoleSignal role. Bindings are synchronized at sign-in.

pipeline_destinations.title: Pipeline destinations
pipeline_destinations.subtitle: External sinks pipelines can deliver to.
pipeline_destinations.empty_description: Add an S3 / Kafka / webhook connector to use as a pipeline sink.
pipeline_destinations.delete_confirm_description: Pipelines using this connector will start failing until rewired.
pipeline_destinations.field_kind_hint: Pick the connector type — the configuration fields below adapt to it.

hints.region: AWS region the log group lives in.
hints.log_group: CloudWatch log group to pull events from.
hints.target_stream: Stream that ingested records are written to.
hints.credentials: Optional — stored encrypted and masked after saving.
hints.bucket: Destination bucket objects are written to.
hints.prefix: Optional key prefix for written objects.
hints.sasl: Optional — leave blank for unauthenticated brokers.

cipher_keys.title: Cipher keys
cipher_keys.subtitle: Encryption keys for at-rest column ciphering. Owner-only.
cipher_keys.empty_description: Create a key to enable column-level encryption on sensitive streams.
cipher_keys.delete_confirm_description: Data encrypted with this key will become unreadable.
cipher_keys.rotate_drawer_subtitle: Paste the new 32-byte base64-encoded key material.
cipher_keys.create_drawer_subtitle: Provide a name and 32-byte base64-encoded key material.

regex_patterns.title: Regex patterns
regex_patterns.subtitle: Reusable regex shortcuts, also used for sensitive-data masking.
regex_patterns.empty_description: Create reusable regex shortcuts for VRL transforms.
regex_patterns.field_replacement_hint: Matched text is replaced with this. Supports $1 capture groups; leave empty to delete the match.
regex_patterns.field_apply_on_ingest_hint: Permanently redact matches at write time. When off, only the mask(col) query function applies this rule.

domain_management.title: Domain management
domain_management.subtitle: Custom domains with managed TLS certificates.
domain_management.empty_description: Add a hostname to terminate TLS for this org.
domain_management.delete_confirm_description: TLS termination for this hostname will stop.

organization_management.title: Organization management
organization_management.subtitle: Manage tenant organizations from the _sys workspace.
organization_management.empty_description: Create the first tenant organization for this MoleSignal instance.
organization_management.create_drawer_subtitle: Platform administrators create tenant organizations from _sys.
organization_management.form_invalid: Enter both a workspace name and slug.
organization_management.enable_description: Restore access to {{name}} and allow its members and credentials to use the organization again.
organization_management.disable_description: Pause access to {{name}} immediately. Existing sessions and API credentials will be rejected until it is enabled again.
organization_management.last_enabled: At least one tenant organization must remain enabled.
organization_management.delete_description: Permanently delete {{name}}. This action is only available from _sys.
organization_management.delete_disabled: The system organization is immutable, and at least one tenant organization must remain.

nodes.title: Nodes / remote clusters
nodes.subtitle: Manage the local data plane, cluster federation, and remote query targets.
nodes.remote_clusters_description: Federated query targets. Adding a cluster requires the federated_search license.

service_graph.title: Service data source
service_graph.subtitle: Control how the service map is built from traces for single-node or multi-ingest deployments.
service_graph.storage_hint: A single node periodically rebuilds the service map from stored traces. Results are correct across nodes with a 1–2 minute delay.
service_graph.ingest_hint: Each ingest process pairs spans in memory and flushes them. Latency is low, but spans split across nodes may be undercounted.

client_ip.title: RUM client IP recognition
client_ip.subtitle: Choose how this deployment identifies client addresses at the RUM ingest boundary. Proxy headers are trusted only when the TCP peer matches an approved CIDR.
client_ip.resolver_subtitle: This database-backed setting is shared by the deployment and refreshes across collector nodes without restarting them.

mode_hints.peer: Uses the TCP peer address and ignores all forwarding headers. This is the secure default for a directly exposed collector.
mode_hints.header: Reads one bare IP from the configured header, but only for requests arriving from a trusted proxy.
mode_hints.forwarded_chain: Walks the configured IP chain from right to left, skips trusted proxies, and selects the first untrusted address.

client_ip.header_hint: Use a dedicated CDN or proxy header. Authorization, Cookie, API key, and client-certificate headers are blocked.
client_ip.trusted_cidrs_hint: One IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR per line, up to 64. Wildcard /0 networks are accepted, but trust every connection source in that address family; use them only behind a protected ingress. The header is ignored when the connection peer is outside these networks.
client_ip.chain_strategy_hint: The strategy is fixed to rightmost_untrusted. The second field limits the number of addresses accepted from a request (1–64).
client_ip.fallback_hint: Use the TCP peer if the trusted header is missing, malformed, too long, or has no usable client address.
client_ip.allow_private_hint: Permit private, loopback, and link-local addresses resolved from a trusted header. Leave off for public browser traffic.

validation.chain_length: Maximum chain length must be a whole number from 1 to 64.
validation.header: Enter a valid, non-sensitive HTTP header name (maximum 128 characters).
validation.cidrs: Enter 1–64 trusted IPv4 or IPv6 CIDRs, one per line.

federation.title: Cluster federation
federation.subtitle: Synchronize resource changes across clusters. Advanced parameters save together, and disabling federation requires confirmation.
federation.disable_confirm_description: Sending and receiving cross-cluster resource changes will stop. Existing local data is not affected.

hints.cluster_id: A stable, unique identifier for this cluster. It must be unique in the federation and remain unchanged across restarts. Leave blank to disable federation.

nodes.empty_description: Add a remote cluster to enable federated search.
nodes.license_note: Federated search requires a license; OSS deployments cannot configure remote clusters.
nodes.delete_confirm_description: Federated queries will no longer fan out to this target.
nodes.field_token_secret_hint: Reference to secret manager — inline tokens rejected.

org_map.title: Org mappings
org_map.description: Map this cluster's orgs to local orgs for cross-cluster config sync. Unmapped orgs are rejected on receive.
org_map.field_token_hint: Optional. env:VAR or cipher_keys:<id>. Falls back to the cluster token.

correlation.title: Correlation
correlation.subtitle: Cross-signal pivot providers and presets.
correlation.empty_description: Cross-signal pivots will appear here once correlation provider configs are populated.

ai_toolsets.title: AI toolsets
ai_toolsets.subtitle: Registered tools Mole Agent can call.
ai_toolsets.empty_description: Register constrained Mole Agent tools when Mole Intelligence is enabled.
ai_toolsets.builtin_hint: Only the checked built-in tools are exposed to the model for this org. Leave all checked to allow everything.
ai_toolsets.custom_hint: Define tools that proxy to your own HTTP endpoint; the model calls them and the backend POSTs to the URL.

model_pricing.title: Model pricing
model_pricing.subtitle: LLM model pricing matrix used for billing.
model_pricing.empty_description: Add provider/model pricing rows for LLM cost accounting.

query_management.title: Query management
query_management.subtitle: In-flight queries and recent inspector activity.
query_management.already_cancelled: This query has already been cancelled.
query_management.empty_description: Long-running queries will appear here while they execute.

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: Search the audit trail by time, actor, action, and target.
audit.empty_description: No events match the current filters.

ai_providers.title: AI providers
ai_providers.subtitle: Model providers and encrypted API keys for AI investigation.
ai_providers.empty_description: Add an approved model provider to enable Mole Intelligence chat.
ai_providers.field_api_key_hint_create: Stored encrypted; shown only as last 4 digits after saving.
ai_providers.field_api_key_hint_edit: Leave blank to keep the existing key; use Rotate key to change it.

field_masking.title: Field masking
field_masking.subtitle: Global rules use first-match order; stream fields can override or disable inherited masking. Queries compute on raw values and mask only final results; metrics streams are excluded.
field_masking.empty_description: Create a global fallback rule or configure a stream-level field override.
field_masking.drawer_subtitle: The first matching rule wins. Drag rows to change priority.
field_masking.field_pattern_hint: Supports exact names and * or ? wildcards; regular expressions are not accepted.
field_masking.field_stream_pattern_hint: Leave empty for every stream; supports * and ? wildcards.
field_masking.field_replacement_hint: The matched region is replaced once with this value.

algorithm_hints.full: Replace the entire field with a fixed value.
algorithm_hints.inner: Keep a prefix and suffix while masking the middle.
algorithm_hints.outer: Keep only the [start, end) range and mask both sides.
algorithm_hints.hash: Create a deterministic digest with an organization-scoped backend-managed key.

ai_prompts.title: AI prompts
ai_prompts.subtitle: Built-in and custom prompt templates for AI investigation.
ai_prompts.empty_description: Built-in prompts should appear here once the backend is reachable.
ai_prompts.field_body_hint: Use {{variables}} allowed by this purpose; unknown variables are rejected.
